gloss: management team; executive team; top management

definitions.gloss: management team; executive team; top management
definitions.explanation: The group of people who manage and run a company or organization at the highest level, including the CEO, directors, and other executives.

examples.japanese: {経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{労働組合|ろうどうくみあい}→労働組合：16096_roudoukumiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations between management and the labor union have begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: Under the new management team, the company's performance recovered.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (management, running a business) and ⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧ (group, camp). The suffix ⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧ implies a cohesive group working together, often in a leadership or strategic capacity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刷新|さっしん}→刷新：07520_sasshin⟧: renewal of the management team
- {経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: management's responsibility
- {経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{退陣|たいじん}→退陣：25312_taijin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: management steps down
- {経営陣|けいえいじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧: to join the management team

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧: manager, business owner — refers to an individual, not a group
- ⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧: board member, officer — individual executive
- ⟦{幹部|かんぶ}→幹部：06875_kanbu⟧: executive, leader — broader term for leadership in any organization
